meta.name: Warehouse — Section 3 Parcel Sortation & Dispatch Cell
meta.mode: Distinct warehouse functions — Section 1 pallet storage, Section 2 loading bay, Section 3 conveyor parcel sortation and dispatch, Section 4 IT & logistics dispatch hub
meta.axes: Three.js X/Z world axes, Y up. In the top-down reference render, positive X appears toward screen-left and positive Z toward screen-top; numbered sections follow that visible blueprint orientation.
meta.note: Section 1 storage and Section 2 loading bay preserved. Section 3 is redesigned as a parcel sortation and dispatch cell: elevated belt conveyors, branch sort lanes, barcode scan arch, induction/exception stations, destination roll cages, packing bench, safety markings and equipment. Section 4 and central hall unchanged.
meta.sectionArchitecture: Each numbered quadrant has an enclosing chamber, recessed entry returns, two cross-corridor links, one side-aisle link, and three auxiliary service bays. All quadrant wall geometry is mirrored on both axes.

sectionProgress.section1: long north-south pallet-rack aisles; 20 pallet bases and 32 crate loads
sectionProgress.section2: unique east-west cross-racks; static forklift loading bay; drums, safety cones, spare pallets and workbench
sectionProgress.section3: conveyor parcel sortation cell with barcode scan arch, branch lanes, destination cages, packing and exception stations
